speaker: Unknown
en: And then when you're in exploitation mode, it's like focusing your resources on climbing that mountain effectively.

en: If you do too much exploration, you can have your team feel a little bit too scattershot, just trying a hundred different random ideas.

speaker: Unknown
en: So one of the PMs that we have, Dylan, he works on all the learning features.
zh: 所以我们的一位产品经理 Dylan,他负责所有的学习功能。

speaker: Unknown
en: The most used learning feature in our product is called game review.
zh: 我们产品中最常用的学习功能叫做复盘。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you play a game of chess, after the game is over, we have this virtual coach that teaches you about your worst moves, best moves, et cetera.
zh: 所以你下了一盘国际象棋,游戏结束后,我们有这个虚拟教练教你关于你最糟糕的招法,最好的招法等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: And his job is to improve user engagement and retention.
zh: 他的工作是提高用户参与度和留存率。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so he's in this exploratory phase trying to figure out how do I drive more of that type of activity?
zh: 所以他处于这个探索阶段,试图弄清楚如何推动更多的这类活动?

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
